Card Q&A.a: No. If an effect unsuspends a card that's already unsuspended, it doesn't count as unsuspending it.
Card Q&A.q: I have a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards. If that Digimon is already unsuspended, does this card's inherited effect activate during my unsuspend phase?

Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] When this Digimon becomes unsuspended during your unsuspend phase, gain 1 memory.
